description: Empirical output-power-density vs emitter-temperature lookup for a Cs-vapor thermionic diode. Breakpoints from ideal Richardson-Dushman emission J=A*Te^2*exp(-phi_e/(k*Te)), output voltage V=phi_emitter-phi_collector, P=J*V.
source: Hatsopoulos & Gyftopoulos (1979) Thermionic Energy Conversion; Angrist (1982) Direct Energy Conversion

phi_emitter.note: Emitter work function (reused from EC218 F1a)

lookup.note: Breakpoints: emitter temperature (K) -> output power density (W/m^2)

power_density_W_m2.note: ~204 W/cm^2 at 1700 K (ideal, no space-charge loss)
